**`AGENTS.md` in this same folder is the canonical instruction file for every agent, whatever
the vendor.** Read it first. This file exists only so a Claude session that looks for
`CLAUDE.md` by name is pointed at it, and is kept deliberately thin so the two can never
disagree.

Machine-wide and Dropbox-wide rules still load from `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` and
`<Dropbox>/CLAUDE.md` as usual — `AGENTS.md` does not replace those.
